title: Splitting server.ts: the plan
summary: Sign off a refactor before any code moves: the plan drawn, then scope, PR strategy and how strict to be about behaviour.
description: `api/server.ts` has grown to 2,412 lines: routes, validation, queries and emails in one file. Here is how I'd split it. Nothing moves until you've answered; my picks are pre-selected.

fields.text:

| Largest file | 2,412 lines | ~300 lines |
| Routes with a test | 0 of 38 | 38 of 38 (snapshot) |
| Circular imports | 4 | 0 |

Every route keeps its path, its input and its response. I record all 38 routes' responses before the move and diff them after.
